commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
SERIAL="$(PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -m aicall_tools.device.s22_adb_discovery)"
CURRENT="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am get-current-user 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')"
echo "ANDROID_CURRENT_USER=$CURRENT"
for PKG in pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.s8lab; do
  case "$PKG" in *.s8lab) LABEL=LAB;; *) LABEL=PROD;; esac
  set +e
  OUTPUT="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path --user 0 "$PKG" 2>&1)"
  CODE="$?"
  set -e
  echo "${LABEL}_USER0_PATH_EXIT=$CODE"
  echo "${LABEL}_USER0_PATH_COUNT=$(printf '%s\n' "$OUTPUT" | grep -c '^package:' || true)"
done
set +e
PACKAGES="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm list packages --user 0 2>&1)"
CODE="$?"
set -e
echo "USER0_PACKAGE_LIST_EXIT=$CODE"
if printf '%s\n' "$PACKAGES" | grep -Fxq 'package:pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge'; then echo "PROD_USER0_LISTED=true"; else echo "PROD_USER0_LISTED=false"; fi
if printf '%s\n' "$PACKAGES" | grep -Fxq 'package:pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.s8lab'; then echo "LAB_USER0_LISTED=true"; else echo "LAB_USER0_LISTED=false"; fi
echo "USER0_PROBE_DONE=true"
commands.output:
ANDROID_CURRENT_USER=0
PROD_USER0_PATH_EXIT=1
PROD_USER0_PATH_COUNT=0
LAB_USER0_PATH_EXIT=0
LAB_USER0_PATH_COUNT=1
USER0_PACKAGE_LIST_EXIT=0
PROD_USER0_LISTED=false
LAB_USER0_LISTED=true
USER0_PROBE_DONE=true
